text: Eating well is the foundation of a healthy life. A balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains gives your body the energy it needs, while limiting processed foods and sugar helps prevent fatigue. However, food alone isn't enough. Regular exercise, even a daily thirty-minute walk, strengthens your heart and boosts your mood. Equally important is quality sleep—aim for seven to nine hours each night, as it allows your body to repair itself. Finally, don't forget your mental health. Managing stress through hobbies or mindfulness and keeping a healthy work-life balance are essential. When you care for both your body and mind, you feel more energetic and resilient every day.
